card.name: Last digit in long reference numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit that ends or nearly ends a long number, such as a PO box, street number, page range or case number, usually just before a city, state, or hyphen.

modes.label: Address numbers
modes.description: Final digit of a PO box or street number before a city and state.

modes.label: Citation pages and volumes
modes.description: Digit inside page numbers or article numbers in reference lists.

modes.label: Case or year numbers
modes.description: Digit closing a court case number or a round year count.

card.plain: It marks the last digits of long numbers such as PO boxes, page ranges and case numbers in addresses and references.
